data.name: Rudaul
data.gender_notes: Rudaul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rudaul is an Arabic name derived from 'Rahman', one of the 99 names of Allah, meaning 'the All-Compassionate'. It signifies a strong connection with the divine. The name Rudaul carries the meaning “Servant of the All-Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rudaul usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of the all-compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rudaul is associated with the divine attribute of mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Rudaul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of the All-Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rudaul total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: رضال
in_arabic.meaning: منحوت و مشهورة، مشهورة و مرغوبة، جميل و مضيء

in_urdu.name: رضال
